images.title: A time scale in powers of 10
images.purpose: Places a ball falling, a cup of tea, about 11.57 days and about 31 years on a scale where each step is 10 times the last.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text. One long horizontal scale across the middle with evenly spaced ticks and four marked events.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal grey (#6B7280) line with exactly 10 evenly spaced ticks for 10 to the powers 0 to 9 seconds. Only 4 ticks are labelled under the line: '10⁰ s', '10² s', '10⁶ s', '10⁹ s'. Above each of those 4 ticks, a teal (#0072B2) dot and a short label: 'ball falls', 'cup of tea', '11.57 days', '31 years'. The 10⁹ tick and its dot are reddish purple (#CC79A7). Exactly 10 ticks, 4 dots.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each step up the scale multiplies the time by 10.
images.description: Places a ball falling, a cup of tea, about 11.57 days and about 31 years on a scale where each step is 10 times the last.
images.context: 10 to the power 6 s ≈ 11.57 days; 10 to the power 9 s ≈ 31 years. One year ≈ 3.15 × 10 to the power 7 s.
images.teaching_notes: The gap from 11.57 days to 31 years is only three steps.

image_decisions.why: The scale shows how powers of 10 seconds grow, which is the sense of size this concept builds.
